summary: CRITICAL FIX VERIFIED: The `ReferenceError: siloLive is not defined` crash from iteration_23 is resolved. Feed Program SPA (/?farm=default) now mounts cleanly for the owner via the magic link — zero pageerrors, dashboard/tabs/summary/shed grids all render. All 6 previously-blocked review items on the Program side pass; Reader sanity re-confirmed on 390px. Backend PATCH /api/silos/{id} verified from the browser network log (200 with body `{"active":true,"manualOverride":true}`). Persistence across reload works. One MINOR frontend UX gap: after clicking a header toggle the PATCH succeeds and backend updates, but the button color does not refresh in the currently-open tab until the user reloads/switches tabs (App's `liveSiloConfig` is not re-fetched after `patchSiloActive`).

ui_bugs.issue: No optimistic/post-PATCH local refresh. Clicking `silo-header-toggle-<idx>-<A|B|C>` fires a valid PATCH /api/silos/{id} (200 OK) but the button's own color/title stays on the pre-click value until page reload or tab switch. Reader-side chip and post-reload Program state both correctly reflect the new value, so this is a UI-only staleness issue on the Program.

issues: Silo A/B/C ⏻ toggles are quite small (visible but require squinting on a 1920px viewport); consider bumping size or adding a hover-scale so growers on tablets see them more readily.

action_items: MINOR: After a successful PATCH inside App's `patchSiloActive`, update the local `liveSiloConfig` state (either optimistically before the network call, or re-hydrate from the PATCH response body which already contains the full updated silo record) so the header ⏻ flips color immediately without requiring a reload.

OPTIONAL: The disabled/loading grey state observed in iteration_23 is no longer visible under normal conditions (autoSync populates `liveSiloConfig` before the header toggles are rendered in most cases). Leaving as-is is fine, but consider a `key` on the button or a subtle skeleton if slower networks show the grey state noticeably.
critical_code_review_comments: App.tsx now safely owns its own `liveSiloConfig` state + `patchSiloActive` — the cross-component ReferenceError is gone. Good.
PATCH `patchSiloActive` should merge the response back into `liveSiloConfig` (the endpoint returns the full updated silo). Currently it does not, causing the UI-refresh gap noted above.

App.tsx remains ~14k lines. Re-flagging: split into components/hooks. The header-toggle rendering (SheetView ~L2132) and the App-side owner logic (~L10082) should each live in their own file so this class of scoping bug can't recur.
